metadata.title: Async Processing Queue for Large Specs

story.iWant: background job processing for large spec uploads (≥100 endpoints)
story.soThat: the webhook endpoint remains responsive even for large catalogs
story.tasks: - Task 1: Install and Configure pg-boss (AC: 8) - Task 2: Create Spec Processing Worker (AC: 2, 5, 6) - Task 3: Update Webhook Endpoint to Queue Large Specs (AC: 1, 7) - Task 4: Create Job Status API Endpoint (AC: 3, 4) - Task 5: Implement Dead Letter Queue Handling (AC: 6) - Task 6: Add Structured Logging for Job Processing (AC: 2, 5, 6) - Task 7: Write Unit Tests for Job Queue (AC: 2, 5, 6, 8) - Task 8: Write Integration Tests for Async Webhook Flow (AC: 1, 3, 4, 7) - Task 9: Update API Documentation (AC: 1, 3, 4)

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Large spec (≥100 endpoints) returns 202 Accepted with job_id in <500ms 2. Background worker extracts endpoints, stores in database, marks job completed 3. GET /api/v1/jobs/{job_id} returns job status (queued/processing/completed/failed) 4. Failed jobs include error details with message, details, retry_count 5. Job retries with exponential backoff (1s, 4s, 16s) max 3 retries 6. Failed jobs after max retries move to dead letter queue 7. Small specs (<100 endpoints) process synchronously with 200 OK response 8. Worker pool configured with 5 parallel workers, 2-minute timeout per job

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: Queue System: pg-boss (PostgreSQL-based) chosen for production. No Redis dependency. Retry strategy: exponential backoff with max 3 retries. Job timeout: 2 minutes per spec processing.

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: Queue structure: apps/api/src/queue/boss.ts for setup, apps/api/src/queue/workers/ for worker implementations. Jobs integrated with Fastify plugin pattern.

doc.title: Epic Breakdown
doc.snippet: Async processing queue for specs with ≥100 endpoints. BullMQ (Redis) or pg-boss (Postgres) options. Job payload includes spec_json, api_id, version_id, environment. Worker pool: configurable concurrency (default 5).

doc.title: Previous Story - Multi-Environment Version History
doc.snippet: Established patterns: VersionHistoryService class pattern, Fastify plugin registration in app.ts, TypeBox schemas for all routes, structured logging with fastify.log, comprehensive unit and integration tests. All 316 tests passing.

story-context.constraints: - MUST use pg-boss (PostgreSQL-based queue) per architecture decision - no Redis dependency - MUST return 202 Accepted for specs with ≥100 endpoints - MUST return 200 OK for specs with <100 endpoints (synchronous processing) - MUST implement exponential backoff retry: 1s, 4s, 16s (max 3 retries) - MUST use Fastify plugin pattern for dependency injection - MUST return standard error response format: { error: { code, message, details? } } - MUST use TypeBox schemas for request/response validation - MUST set job timeout to 2 minutes per spec processing - MUST use configurable worker concurrency (default 5 workers) - Job processing MUST be idempotent (safe to retry) - Dead letter queue MUST capture permanently failed jobs - Database container is named "database" (for connection string) - All paths must be project-relative (no absolute paths)

tests.standards: Testing follows existing patterns: unit tests in apps/api/src/__tests__/ for services and plugins, integration tests in apps/api/src/__tests__/integration/ for end-to-end flows. Use @prisma/client for database access in tests. All tests use pnpm test command. Maintain 316+ passing tests. Follow TypeScript strict mode. Mock external dependencies. Use descriptive test names with Given/When/Then pattern.
tests.ideas: - AC 1,7: Test webhook returns 202 for ≥100 endpoints, 200 for <100 - AC 2: Test worker successfully processes job (mock extraction, verify storage) - AC 3,4: Test job status API returns correct status for all states - AC 5: Test retry logic with exponential backoff (1s, 4s, 16s) - AC 6: Test DLQ captures jobs after max retries - AC 8: Test worker concurrency configuration (5 parallel workers) - Integration: Full flow from webhook → queue → worker → status check - Error cases: Invalid spec in worker, extraction failure, timeout
